responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the module files. compiler/rustc_middle/src/thir/visit.rs: Defines the standard traversal interface for THIR trees by exposing a `Visitor` trait and default walk functions for expressions, statements, blocks, match arms, and patterns. This file coordinates recursive navigation through THIR node storage in `Thir`, specifying which child THIR nodes are visited for each `ExprKind`, `StmtKind`, and `PatKind` so analyses can override selected hooks while reusing the canonical walk.
